ministry_names.legal_basis: 정부조직법 법률 제5153호 (1996-08-08, 제29조①②, 해양수산부 신설) in force at window start. Continued by 법률 제5529호 (전부개정, 1998-02-28, 제26조①②, 제43조) without a change of name. Abolished by 법률 제8852호 (전부개정, 2008-02-29, 부칙 제2조 표), functions split between 국토해양부 (해양정책·항만·해운) and 농림수산식품부 (수산)
re-created by 정부조직법 법률 제11690호 (전부개정, 2013-03-23, 제26조, 제43조, 부칙 제3조제1항 표) from 국토해양부 (해양) and 농림수산식품부 (수산). Still listed in 법률 제21065호 (version effective 2026-01-02, 제29조①②)
No separate oceans ministry. The functions sat in 국토해양부 (lineage 'land') and 농림수산식품부 (lineage 'agriculture'). Their ministers are compiled in those lineages and not repeated here

spells.notes: Kim Young-sam appointee (8·5 개각 1997) who stayed as caretaker after the 1998-02-25 inauguration until the first 김대중 cabinet was appointed on 1998-03-03. The reshuffle was announced on 1997-08-05 and the 임명장 was given on the morning of 1997-08-06 (연합뉴스). The ministry page and ko.wikipedia give 1997-08-07, which no same-day report supports. No digital gazette exists before 2001. 법률 제5529호 (effective 1998-02-28) kept the name 해양수산부, so the spell is not split. End is the successor's appointment day, the day the outgoing ministers held their farewell ceremonies (매일경제 1998-03-04). The ministry page and ko.wikipedia use 1998-03-02, the day before. spells.notes: First minister of the re-created ministry. Named by 대통령당선인 박근혜 on 2013-02-17, but the ministry only came into existence on 2013-03-23 (법률 제11690호), so the hearing request went to the Assembly on 2013-03-25. Appointed on 2013-04-17 although the committee did not adopt the 인사청문경과보고서. Dismissed (해임) on 2014-02-06 on 국무총리 정홍원's 해임건의 after remarks on the 여수 우이산호 oil spill. The second use of the PM's 해임건의 after 최낙정 (2003). She held a farewell ceremony on 2014-02-12, the date ko.wikipedia uses as the end. News from 02-07 on calls her '전 장관' and the ministry page ends her term on 02-06. spells.notes: Former 한국해양과학기술원장, named on 2023-12-04. Appointed without an adopted 인사청문경과보고서. Stayed in office through the suspension (2024-12-14) and removal (2025-04-04) of 윤석열 under the acting presidents 한덕수, 최상목, 한덕수 and 이주호, and into the 이재명 presidency (still acting as minister on 2025-06-20, 부산일보 2025-06-20 ""선원의 중요성 알린다" 제2회 선원의 날 기념식" (BigKinds metadata, news_id 01500701.20250620185355001, query '강도형 해수부 장관' 2025-06-04..2025-06-20, snapshot roster/sources/oceans/bigkinds/bk_5540d42d03.json, accessed 2026-09-25T14:09:20-0400)). He held his farewell ceremony on 2025-07-23 (ministry photo news), the evening the President approved 전재수's appointment, which the gazette dates 2025-07-24. End follows the farewell day and the ministry page (2025-07-23), contiguous with the successor's start. Ko.wikipedia gives 07-24. spells.notes: Career 해양수산부 official (former 기획조정실장), named on 2026-03-02, 81 days after 전재수's resignation (문화일보 2026-03-02). The committee adopted the report on 2026-03-23. issues.desc: No 관보 exists for the 1998-2000 spells (조정제, 김선길, 정상천, 이항규, 노무현 start). Their dates rest on same-day news (연합뉴스 via Naver, BigKinds metadata) and the 해양수산부 역대장관 page. For the 2000-01-13 reshuffle the announcement (01-13) and the 임명장 (01-14) fall on different days. The roster uses the 임명장 day for both the outgoing and incoming minister. For 조정제 the 임명장 day 1997-08-06 is used, not the announcement day 08-05 or the ministry page's 08-07.

The 해양수산부 역대장관 page (mof.go.kr menuSeq=418) and ko.wikipedia often end a spell on the day before the successor's appointment (e.g. 김선길 1999-03-22, 정우택 2001-09-06, 유삼남 2002-07-10, 김영석 2017-06-15, 김영춘 2019-04-02, 문성혁 2022-05-09, 조승환 2023-12-28). Where same-day news shows the outgoing minister still in office or holding the farewell on the successor's day, the roster uses that day (same-day handover). Downstream code that counts days must treat the shared day consistently.

Three starts differ from the 임명장/취임식 day because the gazette prints an earlier legal date. They are 유기준 (gazette and ministry page 2015-03-13, 임명장 and 취임식 2015-03-16), 전재수 (재가 2025-07-23 evening, gazette 2025-07-24) and 황종우 (재가 2026-03-24, gazette 2026-03-25). The roster follows the gazette. For 오거돈 the reshuffle was announced on 2005-01-04 and the gazette dates the appointment 2005-01-05.

윤진숙's end is the 해임 day 2014-02-06 (정홍원's 해임건의 accepted the same day, ministry page 02-06). She held a farewell on 2014-02-12, which ko.wikipedia uses as the end. 청와대 announced the 해임 on the evening of 2014-02-06, two hours after the 해임건의 (프레시안, 헤럴드경제). The gazette does not print exits, so the formal 면직 date could not be read from a tier-1 source.

The oceans lineage has no ministry from 2008-02-29 to 2013-03-22 (offices.json lineage_gaps). The ports, shipping and ocean-policy functions sat in 국토해양부 (lineage 'land') and fisheries in 농림수산식품부 (lineage 'agriculture'). Those ministers are not repeated here. 강무현's spell ends 2008-02-28 (ministry_reorganized) and he did not hold either successor office.

Naver News search returned HTTP 403 or empty pages for most queries during this run (shared rate limit), so most news citations are BigKinds metadata (date, outlet, title, snippet, saved result lists) plus Naver-hosted articles found through other agents' caches. Full texts were not retrieved for the BigKinds hits.

Invalid-type transcript rows (국회본회의, 예산결산특별위원회, 국정조사) put 김성진 (2002), 강무현 (2003), 김영석 (2012), 김영춘 (2012-2013), 조승환 (2014-2017), 문성혁 (2014-2016) and 강도형 (2023-01) outside their spells. These match the audit's caveat about misattached meeting dates and are ignored. All rows of valid types (상임위원회, 국정감사) fall inside the spells.

Birth date not found for 이항규 (age 62 in 매일경제 2000-01-15) and only the year for 강무현 (1951, 머니투데이 2007-04-19). Other birth dates come from na_members_15_22.csv (MPs) or ko.wikipedia (tier 4). name_en is left null for all spells because no official romanization was collected.

Day-level continuity (script oceans_13_continuity.py). No overlaps. Every other handover is same-day or contiguous. Vacancies with no appointed minister are 2003-10-03..2003-10-13 after 최낙정's dismissal (차관 김영남 acting), 2006-03-22..2006-03-26 after 오거돈's resignation (차관 강무현 in post, no saved report names a 직무대행), 2013-03-23..2013-04-16 for the re-created ministry (no minister or 차관 on 03-23, 차관 손재학 from 03-24), 2014-02-07..2014-03-04 after 윤진숙's dismissal (손재학 acting), 2014-12-24..2015-03-12 after 이주영's resignation (김영석 acting) and 2025-12-12..2026-03-24 after 전재수's resignation (김성범 acting). The ministry did not exist from 2008-02-29 to 2013-03-22.

2026 check. 황종우 is in office at the cutoff. The 8·30 개각 2026 changed six other ministries and no resignation, nomination or replacement for 해양수산부 was found up to 2026-09-24. Appointments made on 2026-09-19..09-24 would not yet be printed in the gazette harvest (last issue 2026-09-18), but same-day news on 09-22 still names him as minister. Quoted snippets in the sources are verbatim from the saved BigKinds metadata or Naver pages, whose snippets are often truncated. Glosses and inferences are given in parentheses.

[verifier] end_reason coding differs across lineages for ministers replaced in pre-election reshuffles. Here 김영춘 (3·8 개각 2019, sitting MP, election 13 months away) was recoded replaced, matching 도종환 and 김부겸, and 조승환 (12·4 개각 2023, non-MP who stood in 2024) was recoded resigned_to_run, matching 추경호, 정황근 and others. The panel build should apply one rule for all lineages.

[verifier] Several tier-2 and tier-4 dates were contradicted by tier-1 or same-day tier-3 evidence and not adopted. They are the ministry page's 노무현 start 2000-08-08 and end 2001-03-24, 최낙정 end 2003-10-01 and 이주영 end 2014-12-25, and Namu Wiki's 김호식 start 2002-07-12 and 오거돈 end 2006-03-26.

[verifier] 강무현's farewell took place on 2008-02-29, the day 법률 제8852호 took effect. The roster keeps 2008-02-28 as the office's last day under offices.json, as all lineages do for the 2008 abolitions. 조정제 sent a farewell letter on 1998-02-24 (강원도민일보 1998-02-26) but the roster keeps the 1998-03-03 end, when the caretaker cabinet was replaced.
